display_long_description:
Epic Airplane is a physics-based VR flying game where every flight starts the same thrilling way: grab your plane by both wingtips, pull back like a slingshot, and let go to launch into the sky.

Once airborne, bank and dive through uniquely themed worlds — a lush forest, ancient ruins, a rocky canyon, a snowy mountain pass, and windswept pyramids — each with its own hazards and scenery. Dodge falling obstacles, thread the terrain, and fly as far as you can before gravity brings you back down.

Collect floating coins mid-flight and earn more with every meter flown, then spend them in the Garage to unlock and upgrade a growing fleet of planes. Boost your Speed, lighten your Weight for longer glides, multiply your coin earnings, or save up for emergency mid-flight Boosters — every upgrade is a step toward flying further than before.

Feel every crash, coin, and victory with responsive haptic feedback, and track your best distance as you push to beat your own record.

How far will you fly?
